name: Sebastian
description: Lives in the basement, codes by night, and rides his motorcycle when the coast is clear. Responds well to patience and thoughtful gifts.

seo.title: Sebastian — Programmer
seo.description: Lives in the basement, codes by night, and rides his motorcycle when the coast is clear. Responds well to patience and thoughtful gifts.

stardew.intro: Robin’s introverted stepson who works from home and escapes on his motorcycle. Warmer than he first appears — if you meet him on his schedule.

heartEvents.title: Garage hangout
heartEvents.summary: Find him in Robin’s garage with Sam — stay for awkward small talk.

heartEvents.title: Board game night
heartEvents.summary: Rainy-day invite to play Solarion Chronicles in his room.

heartEvents.title: Pool at the lake
heartEvents.summary: He opens up about feeling like an outsider in his own family.

heartEvents.title: Motorcycle ride
heartEvents.summary: He offers a night ride and asks if you want to leave town together someday.

heartEvents.title: Obsidian gift
heartEvents.summary: Bring obsidian to the mountain after dark for a quiet confession and kiss.

heartEvents.title: Frog encounter
heartEvents.summary: A rainy-day cutscene on the farm ties back to his love of frogs.

relationships.name: Sam & Abigail
relationships.note: His closest friends — band practice and arcade nights.

relationships.name: Maru & Demetrius
relationships.note: Home life is tense; he keeps to the basement to avoid friction.

trivia: Sashimi is loved and only needs any fish — Linus mails you the recipe at 3 hearts.
